Sensitive reports belong in [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Yivas/cotilleo-convo-opencode/security/advisories/new), not here. Credentials, private conversations, prompts, personal paths and model configuration must be removed.

## Change and motivation

Describe the user need, coherent change and any related issue. A host capability or planned feature must not be presented as verified without evidence.

## Verification

List checks actually run and results. Current documentation can be reviewed by reading it and checking affected links. There is no plugin build or supported executable baseline yet; identify checks not run or not applicable.

## Compatibility, risks and documentation

Describe host-contract, permission, privacy and documentation implications, or explain why no compatibility claim applies. Submission does not authorize installation or deployment.

## Confirmation

- [ ] I checked existing issues and the contribution guidance.
